Name: Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1 - Mud's Less Skimpy Anime Portraits
Author: ruunyastardew
Description:
Big thanks to Mud for letting me do this. 
I really like the work Mud did on this mod but felt it worked for an adult only playthrough and wanted to try to make some edits to have a less skimpy version. also made some edits to make the sprites have a vanilla-ish style. 
I greatly underestimated the scale of this mod and this was my first time trying something like this. So more then likely i messed something up, so feel free to point it out and i'll try to make changes as i can. Yes TheMud and TwoCircles have given the ok to try my hand at the other mods on this type, so please give me time (it took me 2 months plus to even get this done)

sprites are edits based on work by TheMud, [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193963893-seasea50/]SeaSea50[/url], binyks, Peasant00, canddleit and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] (if i missed any please let me know)

this was originally made for personal use but Mud gave me the ok to upload it in case anyone else would like to give it a try. 
and again thank you to everyone
